OIML recommendation R49-1 (measuring systems for refueling... actually R49 is water metering? R49-1 is "Measuring systems for cryogenic liquids" part 1? Doesn't matter). The certificate number format: OIML R number / year of the recommendation? Then issuing authority code NL1, then year.sequence.

Hmm, actually the register "R049/2003-NL1-2006.01" — the "2003" is the year of the OIML R edition; "2006.01" is issuing year 2006, cert 01. The document "R49-1/2003-NL1-06.01" — 06.01 = 2006, cert 01. The comment block in the document also says num: R049/2003-NL1-2006.01 and issuing_year: 2006. Per rules: "Number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate = same-entity with the register's canonical form." So verdict same-entity, best_value = register's "R049/2003-NL1-2006.01".

The document's printed number is the legal instrument, but the rule explicitly says register's canonical form for number/year format differences. Also the embedded comment in the document confirms register form. So answer:
